description: Schedules the stream to start at a set time, optionally with an end and a repeat. Replaces any existing schedule.

days.description: weekly: weekdays to start on, in UTC. Omitted: every 7 days.

durationSeconds.description: Instead of endAt: a session ends this long after going live. Required for restart, where it is at least 600. Stored as the stream's streamDuration, so it also ends manual starts and stays after stream_cancel_schedule; stream_update streamDuration 0 removes it.

endAt.description: When a session ends. Needed for daily and weekly. Omitted: runs until stopped.

repeat.description: What happens after a session ends. none: nothing. daily / weekly: the same session again at the same time. restart: run for durationSeconds, stop, wait restartGapSeconds, start a new session, and so on until stopped; e.g. restart every 12 hours with a 30 s break is durationSeconds 43200, restartGapSeconds 30.

restartGapSeconds.description: restart: seconds between one session ending and the next starting. 0: right away.

startAt.description: Start time with the user's UTC offset, e.g. 2026-09-22T06:00:00-04:00. No offset: refused.

name: stream_schedule
title: Schedule stream
